en.text: Sing to the LORD a new song, for he has done marvelous things! His right hand and his holy arm have worked salvation for him.

zhSimplified.text: 你们要向耶和华唱新歌！

zhTraditional.text: 你們要向耶和華唱新歌！

en.text: The LORD has made known his salvation. He has openly shown his righteousness in the sight of the nations.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华发明了他的救恩，

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華發明了他的救恩，

en.text: He has remembered his loving kindness and his faithfulness toward the house of Israel. All the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.

zhSimplified.text: 记念他向家所发的慈爱，所凭的信实。

zhTraditional.text: 記念他向家所發的慈愛，所憑的信實。

en.text: Make a joyful noise to the LORD, all the earth! out and sing for joy, yes, sing praises!

zhSimplified.text: 全地都要向耶和华欢乐；

zhTraditional.text: 全地都要向耶和華歡樂；

en.text: Sing praises to the LORD with the harp, with the harp and the voice of melody.
With trumpets and sound of the ram’s horn, a joyful noise before the King, the LORD.
Let the sea roar with its fullness; the world, and those who dwell therein.

zhSimplified.text: 愿海和其中所充满的澎湃；

zhTraditional.text: 願海和其中所充滿的澎湃；

en.text: Let the rivers clap their hands. the mountains sing for joy together.
Let them sing before the LORD, for he comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness, and the peoples with equity.
